---
pagetitle: "Trial plan"
execute:
  freeze: false
  echo: false
format:
  html:
    page-layout: custom
    toc: false
    css: ../assets/field.css
    include-after-body:
      text: <script src="../assets/field.js"></script>
---

<!--
Prototype: the shared code catalogue drawn as a field trial. Each package
is a plot, blocks are organisations, and the crop in a plot shows how
active the package is.

  scripts/trial_plan.R  builds the plots, entries and filter chips
  assets/field.css      styles
  assets/field.js       layout, pan/zoom, plot cards and filters
-->

```{r}
#| include: false
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

source(here("scripts/00_helpers.R"))
source(here("scripts/trial_plan.R"))

df <- read_csv(here("data/processed/submissions_cleaned.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

metrics_file <- here("data/processed/package_metrics.csv")
if (file.exists(metrics_file)) {
  metrics <- read_csv(metrics_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df <- left_join(df, metrics, by = "Software website")
}

# The metrics file may be missing or out of date; make sure every column the
# page uses exists.
metric_cols <- c(
  "github_stars", "github_followers", "first_commit_date", "last_commit_date",
  "contributors", "cran_package", "cran_downloads_last_month", "cran_downloads_total"
)
for (col in setdiff(metric_cols, names(df))) {
  df[[col]] <- NA
}
df$last_commit_date <- as.Date(df$last_commit_date)

plots <- assign_plots(df)
keywords <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(plots$`Code keywords`, split_tags))))
```

```{r}
header <- tags$header(
  class = "plan-bar",
  div(
    class = "plan-head",
    div(
      class = "plan-title",
      h1("Trial plan"),
      p(
        role = "status",
        strong(id = "n-match", nrow(plots)),
        sprintf(" of %d plots · %d blocks · %s",
                nrow(plots), n_distinct(plots$block), format(Sys.Date(), "%d %b %Y"))
      )
    ),
    div(
      class = "plan-tools",
      tags$label(class = "visually-hidden", `for` = "pl-search", "Search plots"),
      tags$input(
        id = "pl-search", class = "db-search plan-search", type = "search",
        autocomplete = "off", placeholder = "Search packages or people…"
      ),
      tags$button(
        type = "button", class = "filter-btn", id = "pl-filter-btn",
        `aria-expanded` = "false", `aria-controls` = "pl-filters",
        svg_node("svg",
          class = "filter-icon", viewBox = "0 0 16 16", `aria-hidden` = "true",
          svg_node("path", d = "M2 4h12M4 8h8M6.5 12h3")
        ),
        span("Filters"),
        span(class = "filter-badge", id = "pl-filter-n", hidden = NA)
      )
    )
  ),

  div(
    class = "filter-panel", id = "pl-filters", role = "dialog",
    `aria-labelledby` = "fp-title", hidden = NA,
    div(
      class = "fp-head",
      h2(class = "fp-title", id = "fp-title", "Filters"),
      tags$button(type = "button", class = "fp-close", id = "pl-filters-close",
                  `aria-label` = "Close filters", "×")
    ),
    div(
      class = "fp-body",
      facet("f-kw", "Keyword", keyword_chips(keywords)),
      facet("f-st", "Status", status_chips()),
      facet("f-av", "Availability", cran_chip())
    ),
    div(
      class = "fp-foot",
      tags$button(type = "button", class = "chip chip-clear", id = "pl-clear", hidden = NA, "Clear all"),
      tags$button(type = "button", class = "fp-show", id = "pl-show", "Show plots")
    )
  )
)

field <- svg_node("svg",
  class = "plan-svg", id = "plan-svg", xmlns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
  `aria-label` = "Trial plan of shared packages",
  `data-pw` = PLOT_W, `data-ph` = PLOT_H, `data-cg` = COL_GAP,
  `data-rg` = RANGE_GAP, `data-bg` = BLOCK_GAP, `data-pad` = PLAN_PAD,
  svg_node("g",
    id = "world",
    svg_node("rect", class = "ground", x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1),
    lapply(split(plots, plots$letter), block_tag)
  )
)

stage <- div(
  class = "plan-stage",
  div(class = "plan-active", id = "pl-active", `aria-label` = "Active filters", hidden = NA),
  field,
  div(
    class = "legend", id = "legend",
    tags$button(type = "button", class = "legend-toggle", `aria-expanded` = "false",
                `aria-controls` = "legend-items", "Key"),
    div(class = "legend-items", id = "legend-items", `aria-label` = "Key", key_items())
  ),
  div(
    class = "plan-empty", id = "pl-empty", hidden = NA,
    div(
      class = "plan-empty-card", role = "status",
      p(class = "plan-empty-title", "No plots match"),
      p(class = "plan-empty-hint", "Try fewer filters or a broader search."),
      tags$button(type = "button", class = "chip chip-clear", id = "pl-empty-clear", "Clear all")
    )
  ),
  div(
    class = "zoom", role = "group", `aria-label` = "Zoom",
    tags$button(type = "button", id = "z-out", `aria-label` = "Zoom out", "−"),
    tags$button(type = "button", id = "z-fit", "Fit"),
    tags$button(type = "button", id = "z-in", `aria-label` = "Zoom in", "+")
  ),
  # a div rather than an <aside>: Quarto gives asides a high z-index for
  # margin notes, which would put the entry above the filter panel
  div(
    class = "plot-entry", id = "entry", `aria-label` = "Plot entry", `aria-hidden` = "true",
    tags$button(type = "button", class = "e-close", id = "e-close", `aria-label` = "Close", "×"),
    div(class = "e-body", id = "e-body")
  )
)

entries <- div(
  hidden = NA, id = "e-templates",
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(plots)), function(i) entry_template(plots[i, ]))
)

div(class = "plan", id = "plan", header, stage, entries)
```
